levels.surface: أبو الحسين محمد بن جعفر الاسدي
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «جماعة من أصحابنا منهم» names its members, so the named men form the level and no unnamed link is written (rule 8). The gloss «-في حديث له-» is left out.
The Imam «قلت لأبي الحسن موسى» is named only in the words after the chain: last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). Sadiq's words quoted inside the saying are not a route.
